latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Create a Free AI Video skill: generate 1080p MP4 videos from text or image inputs in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB in MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG formats.
- Fully automated setup with free token authentication (100 credits, 7 days)—no user registration required.
- Natural language prompts route to actions: upload, generate, export, check credits, or show status.
- Provides export, draft editing, session management, and clear error feedback for common workflows.
- Designed for content creators and marketers to rapidly turn scripts and photos into polished videos without filming.
